title: A retired research model turns a research request into a blank turn: every research step reports 'ok', the HTTP 404 reaches only the model, and nothing tells the user the model is gone. Settings already offers two retired slugs marked price-verified
repro: Settings > Research > pick 'OpenAI o3 Deep Research' (equivalently X-Vysted-Research-Models=normal=openai/o3-deep-research,deep=...,ultra=...). vy.py invoke researcher 'Research Reliance Industries (RELIANCE, NSE): latest quarter results and outlook. Use only the research tool.' --provider openrouter --model nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free --tier tier_b --header X-Vysted-Research-Models=... --port 52226 -> 5 research tool calls, 10 research_step frames all status 'ok' ('research-model:openai/o3-deep-research - hosted research model (normal stop, via OpenRouter)'), each tool result 'The hosted research model request failed with HTTP 404.', stream ends done finish_reason tool_calls with ZERO assistant text and no error frame. Live catalog check 23 Sep: openai/o4-mini-deep-research and openai/o3-deep-research (Settings options) and perplexity/sonar-reasoning (sonar.py SONAR_MODELS) are absent from https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models.
evidence: docs/redesign/verification/r15/lifecycle/L2-rot/23-retired-research-model.jsonl + .stdout.txt, docs/redesign/verification/r15/lifecycle/L2-rot/22-retired-research-model.*, docs/redesign/verification/r15/lifecycle/L2-rot/24-pinned-slug-catalog-check.txt, src/store/search-settings.ts:112-161 (priceVerified: true on both retired slugs at 144-153), src/components/SettingsPanel.tsx:1003-1007 (static option list, no live-catalog check), sidecar/services/research/sonar.py:49-55, sidecar/services/agent_tools/deep_research.py:682 (engine step emitted 'ok' before the call), :723-724 + :505-523 (HTTPStatusError -> ok:false tool result; no 404 branch), src/store/chat-history.ts:213-219
notes: The chat lane handles a retired slug honestly (errors.py:173-180, 'not available on OpenRouter - pick another model'), but the research lane has its own error table with no 404 case, and its failures never become a stream-visible step or error frame (the same no-surface mechanism as SURF-SETTINGS-PLUGINS-1 for 401, ending in the blank done of SURF-FAILURE-INDUCER-1). Upstream churn is routine: 3 of 18 pinned slugs retired within 3.5 months of being 'verified live 2026-06-11', OpenRouter publishes expiration_date for 21 models today, and nothing in src/ or sidecar/ reads it. When a DEFAULT research stop (search-settings.ts:85-89) retires, every tier-B research run becomes this blank turn. Smallest fix: add 404 -> 'The research model <slug> is no longer available on OpenRouter - pick another in Settings > Research' to _research_model_http_error, emit an error research_step on ok:false, and badge Settings research options that are absent from (or expiring in) the live /llm/models catalog the app already fetches.

title: A dead or moved NSE endpoint is invisible: /health keeps naming nse_direct as primary, provider-health tracks only Yahoo, and the chart silently switches RELIANCE.NS to BSE bars (last-bar volume 10.7M -> 0.56M) under a 'via bse' label
repro: Own sidecar :52226 with HTTPS_PROXY -> loopback CONNECT proxy refusing *.nseindia.com (harness/deadhost_proxy.py). GET /quotes/RELIANCE.NS -> provider bse (was nse_direct); GET /history/RELIANCE.NS?range=3mo -> provider bse, last-bar volume 560,999 vs 10,684,376 on base; GET /health byte-identical to base ('ccxt (nse_direct, nse, bse, yfinance fallback)'); GET /system/provider-health -> yahoo only. Same result with the NSE API path moved (404): /health unchanged, one WARNING per request.
evidence: docs/redesign/verification/r15/lifecycle/L2-rot/http-log.jsonl (profiles base/deadhost/moved, tags Q1/Y1/H1/H2/P1), <scratchpad>/vysted-iso/seat-l2-rot/proxy.jsonl + sidecar-deadhost.log + sidecar-moved.log, sidecar/services/provider_registry.py:552-570 (/health derived from importability), sidecar/services/nse_provider.py:139-146 (available = curl_cffi imports), sidecar/services/provider_health.py:49 (only YAHOO tracked), sidecar/services/provider_registry.py:362-364 (per-request WARNING, no counter), sidecar/services/nse_provider.py:323-341 (breaker counts 401/403 only, so a 404 path is retried on every call), src/modules/chart/ChartPanel.tsx:1420-1421, src/modules/watchlist/WatchlistPanel.tsx:74
notes: The fallback chain works, but the product's exchange-direct lane can be dead for months with no signal to the user or to a maintainer reading /health. Every exchange host and path is a hardcoded constant (nse_provider.py:88-95 and siblings), so recovery needs a release; the only trace is a per-request log WARNING. Mixing exchanges also changes the numbers: BSE volume replaces NSE volume on an .NS chart, and the quote flips from EOD to BSE 'live'. Smallest fix: count fall-throughs per (provider, model_key) in _resolve_sync/_resolve_async, expose them on /system/provider-health, and show one quiet chrome notice ('NSE data unreachable - serving BSE') above a threshold. Distinct from SURF-FAILURE-INDUCER-4 (whole network down, US symbols).

title: Exchange payload field drift is served as fabricated data: renamed high, low, open or volume fields become open=high=low=close candles with zero volume under the exchange's own provider label, and the correctness gate passes them
repro: In-process (harness/parser_drift.py): fetch one real historicalOR window for RELIANCE (8 to 22 Sep, 10 rows), rename CH_OPENING_PRICE/CH_TRADE_HIGH_PRICE/CH_TRADE_LOW_PRICE/CH_TOT_TRADED_QTY, stub nse_provider._get_json to return it, then call provider_registry.get_history('RELIANCE.NS','1d','1mo') -> served, provider nse_direct, 10/10 bars flat (open=high=low=close), 10/10 volume 0.0. Renaming the close field instead -> honest ProviderError and fall-through.
evidence: docs/redesign/verification/r15/lifecycle/L2-rot/30-parser-drift.txt (A0-A4), sidecar/services/nse_provider.py:405-409 ('or close' / 'or 0.0'), sidecar/services/bse_provider.py:240-244 (same pattern), sidecar/services/correctness_gate.py:118-140 (checks only non-empty bars, last close > 0 and symbol match)
notes: This is wrong money-relevant data shown as true, gated on an upstream API revision that is routine over a six-month horizon. Candle bodies, ATR, VWAP, volume indicators and any agent reading price_data would all consume invented values labelled as first-party exchange data. The honest parts of the same lanes (a missing close raises; a bhavcopy header drift parses to {} and degrades with a WARNING) show the intended contract. Smallest fix: map missing OHLV to None instead of close/0.0 (OHLCVBar may need optional fields), or make validate_series reject a series whose bars are all flat and zero-volume, then fall through.

title: A moved NSE archive path is read as a week of holidays: every past trading day's 404 is cached as an empty 'holiday' marker, the only log line is 'no bhavcopy found within 7 days', and after the fix the poisoned days stay skipped
repro: In-process on a fresh scratch cache, 23 Sep ~10:15 IST: UDiFF and legacy URLs moved -> fetch_latest() makes 6 requests (23, 22, 21, 18, 17, 16 Sep), all 404 -> None, and the cache now holds {"empty": true} for 22, 21, 18, 17, 16 Sep. URL restored (the hotfix) with the same cache -> fetch_latest() makes 1 request (today, unpublished, 404) -> None. Control with a clean cache -> 2026-09-22, 2,921 rows. On the live 'moved' sidecar with a warm cache, the lane logged nothing at all.
evidence: docs/redesign/verification/r15/lifecycle/L2-rot/30-parser-drift.txt (C1-C3, D1), <scratchpad>/vysted-iso/seat-l2-rot/sidecar-moved.log (no nse_bhavcopy lines), sidecar/services/nse_bhavcopy.py:345-348 (any 404 -> 'missing', no log), :388-394 (past-date missing -> _EMPTY_MARKER), :101 (7-day TTL), sidecar/services/fundamentals_warm.py:254-265 (the lane that keeps IN prices fresh on a Yahoo-blocked IP returns 0), sidecar/services/nse_symbol_change.py:380-386,418-426
notes: 404 is overloaded as 'holiday or not yet published', so an endpoint move (NSE moved to UDiFF in 2024) is indistinguishable from a long holiday, and the cache then preserves the misreading after the fix. The symbol-change master fails the same way: a moved path logs 'HTTP 404', serves the cached map for up to 30 days under the log label 'network down', then goes inert ('rename lane is a no-op') and renames stop resolving. Screener freshness headers may show old 'quotes as of' dates (not induced, NEEDS-GUI). Related to COD-market-data-providers-1-10 (the BSE pre-publication 404 marker), but a different lane and trigger. Smallest fix: only treat a 404 as a holiday when the date is on the NSE holiday calendar (or when the next trading day's file exists), and log a WARNING naming the URL when N consecutive non-holiday weekdays 404.
